To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a home-made 32-capillary array electrophoretic instrument with 532 nm light-induced fluorescence detection was developed and successfully applied for the enantioseparation of a set of TAMRA SE-Aas in 100 mM of Tris-borate (pH 9.0) containing β-CD and HDA.
the developed method is a promising technique with high-throughput enantioseparation of amino acids.

the 12 TAMRA-AAs were baseline separated within 5 min using a 2 mM β-cyclodextrin and 10 mM HDA as additives in a 100 mM Trist-borate buffer (10.0) and the enantiomers of alanine in non-racemate were determined by CAE-LIF.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a rapid screening method for the optimization of chiral separations in CAE.
a rapid and sensitive method for enantioseparation of AAs by CAE-LIF.
the application of a 532 nm LIF scanner for the rapid enantioseparation of 12 AA enantiomers by a home-made CAE-LIF system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CAE with 532 nm LIF scanner is a promising and efficient tool for high-throughput enantioseparative analysis of TAMRA SE-Aas.
the 532 nm CAELIF system is a promising tool for multiple chiral separations.
the 532 nm CAELIF scanner is a powerful tool for high-throughput chiral separations of AA.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 532 nm CA scanner with TAMRA SE is a promising tool for the rapid enantiomeric analysis of AAs.
the TAMRA SE-CDs-HDA system is a good alternative for chiral AA separations.
the TAMRA SE derivatization reagents are suitable for high-throughput analysis of AA enantiomers by 532 nm CAELIF.
The main takeaway from our work is that
CAE-LIF is a promising method for the enantioseparation of AAs and the determination of ee values.
the CAE-LIF method can be a promising alternative to conventional HPLC for high-throughput analysis of enantiomeric separation of AA.
the TAMRA SE reagent is a very promising chiral derivatizing agent for the analysis of enantiomeric AAs.
